segments.name: consumer
segments.description: Retail organization buying and selling authenticated pre-owned luxury hard assets such as jewelry, watches, and bullion to consumers and business partners.
segments.evidence: The consumer segment focuses on selling authenticated luxury goods, including pre-owned and repurposed fine jewelry, diamonds, gemstones, luxury watches, and secondary-market bullion.

segments.name: commercial
products: reclamation of base and precious metals
segments.description: Provides IT asset disposition, product returns, electronics recycling, and reclamation of base and precious metals for businesses and manufacturers.
segments.evidence: the commercial segment provides solutions for ITAD and product returns, as well as the de-manufacturing of end-of-life electronic assets, the reclamation of base and precious metals, and other saleable materials.

revenueModel.text: Envela earns revenue by buying and reselling secondary-market goods to customers and by charging business partners fee-for-service disposition, returns, and recycling services.
revenueModel.evidence: These fee-for-service relationships allow our business partners to outsource the management of testing and packaging of items for resale while maintaining custody of their inventory.
